channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio propõe aos EUA blindar Pix de sistemas “não ocidentais”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro proposed to the USTR a legislative commitment to block Pix's interconnection with 'non-Western' payment systems in exchange for delaying a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods by 180 days. He argues Pix is a public infrastructure not competing with U.S. firms and that tariffs would harm U.S. investments in Brazil while boosting Lula politically. The proposal was submitted on the final day of the USTR comment period for its Section 301 trade investigation against Brazil.

item.title: Brasil x Noruega: onde apostar, melhores ofertas e odds
item.description: Brazil faces Norway in the Round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup on July 5, with multiple betting sites offering promotions such as boosted odds and free bets for new users. Offers include specific markets like player performances (Vinícius Jr. and Matheus Cunha) and team outcomes (qualification, goals, double chance).

item.title: Fala de Paulo Figueiredo ocorre na esteira de investidas contra o voto feminino nos EUA e no Brasil
item.description: Paulo Figueiredo, YouTuber and son of former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, faced criticism for claiming that women do not know how to vote, in statements made amid efforts to undermine women's voting rights in the U.S. and Brazil. His remarks echoed outdated arguments similar to those of 19th-century U.S. Senator George Vest, reinforcing gender stereotypes in politics. The statement drew widespread backlash for being sexist and antidemocratic.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula é o único que quer tarifaço contra o Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accused President Lula of being the only one seeking U.S. tariffs against Brazil, claiming Lula provoked the U.S. by refusing to label Brazilian criminal factions as terrorists and lobbying for PCC and Comando Vermelho. He said he defends Brazil’s Pix system and will travel to the U.S. on July 6 to urge the cancellation of 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods. Lula responded by calling the Bolsonaro family’s actions 'entreguismo' and accused them of submitting Brazil to U.S. interests.

item.title: Conselho de Comunicação Social debate segurança de jornalistas nas eleições; participe
item.description: The Social Communication Council of the National Congress is holding an interactive public hearing on Monday (6) regarding the safety of journalists covering the 2026 elections. The debate, taking place in Plenary 7 of the Senate Federal, will bring together experts and representatives from organizations defending freedom of expression and the rights of communication professionals.

item.title: Comissão debate a pauta da infância e da adolescência nas eleições de 2026; participe
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Human Rights, Minorities and Racial Equality Commission is holding a public hearing on Tuesday (7) on childhood and adolescence in the 2026 elections, at the request of Deputy Erika Kokay (PT-DF). The debate aims to increase visibility for children's and adolescents' rights in national political discourse, foster dialogue between government branches and civil society, and present proposals from the Agenda 227 movement. The meeting will be at 10 a.m. in a plenary to be defined, with open invitation to submit questions.

item.title: Crusoé: Alfredo Gaspar lidera disputa pelo Senado em Alagoas, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Paraná Institute poll released on April 3 shows federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) leading the Senate race in Alagoas with 40.4% of voter intentions. He is closely followed by Arthur Lira (PP-AL), former Chamber of Deputies president, at 39.8%, and Renan Calheiros (MDB-AL), former Senate president, at 36.4%. The three candidates are technically tied within the margin of error.

item.title: O líder político mais rejeitado do Brasil, segundo nova pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) is Brazil's most rejected political leader, with 90% negative image, according to an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll released July 3, 2026. Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) and federal deputy Aécio Neves (PSDB-MG) follow with 88% rejection each. The survey interviewed 4,999 voters between June 26 and 30, with a 1-point margin of error.

item.title: Bolsonaro não pretende manter em casa a arma apreendida em blitz, diz defesa
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense told Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that the ex-president does not want to keep the firearm seized during a traffic blitz at his home, contradicting his earlier statement that he needed to remain armed. The Glock pistol was found with an Army sergeant during a police stop in Taguatinga, and although the district police concluded Bolsonaro bore no responsibility, Moraes must soon decide whether Bolsonaro returns to the Papudinha prison or remains under house arrest. The PGR had previously supported maintaining house arrest with the weapon confiscated.

item.title: Flávio falará sobre tarifas em audiência nos EUA no dia 7 de julho
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, will speak at a USTR public hearing in Washington D.C. on July 7 to challenge a U.S. trade investigation that could impose new tariffs on Brazil. He will seek to suspend the measures and propose a negotiated resolution, arguing the tariffs would benefit President Lula’s government. The Brazilian government will not send representatives, viewing the hearing as a private-sector and civil society matter.

item.title: Fachin marca retomada de julgamento sobre eleição para mandato-tampão no RJ
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Minister Edson Fachin set August 26 for the resumption of the trial on PSD's actions regarding the interim governor and vice-governor election in Rio de Janeiro. The decision was made on August 2, following Minister Flávio Dino's release of the actions for judgment on July 30.

item.title: Indefinição no Rio prejudica Flávio Bolsonaro em seu berço eleitoral
item.description: The uncertainty over Rio de Janeiro’s state government, still led by Judge Ricardo Couto, undermines Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign in his electoral base, as it keeps the PL out of power and weakens his political machine. While Eduardo Paes (PSD), an ally of Lula, leads with 43% voter intention, the candidate backed by Flávio Bolsonaro trails at 11%, highlighting the decline of Bolsonarism in Rio amid PF investigations and internal party disputes.

item.title: Em nova ofensiva, Flávio defende Pix e promete fechar portas para ‘não ocidentais’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended Pix in a document sent to the USTR, arguing it does not fully replace credit and debit cards, and proposed a legislative commitment to prevent Pix from interconnecting with non-Western international payment platforms. He also urged the delay of U.S. tariffs on Brazil, claiming sanctions on Pix would harm American investments. He rebutted Trump-era criticism by asserting that the alleged conflict of interest involving the Central Bank is exaggerated, comparing Pix’s role to that of the Federal Reserve in the U.S.

item.title: Crusoé: Nordeste menos vermelho
item.description: Latest polls suggest that the PT's hegemony in Brazil's Northeast, the country's second most populous region, may face a significant challenge in the 2026 elections. Opposition candidates to those backed by the PT are showing competitiveness or real chances of winning in states such as Bahia, Ceará, Alagoas, Maranhão, Paraíba, Sergipe, and Pernambuco, indicating a potential weakening of the lulopetista dominance in the region.

item.title: Deputado do PT mira Flávio por atentado à soberania e aciona PGR
item.description: Federal Deputy Jorge Solla (PT-BA) filed a criminal complaint with the PGR against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), accusing him of undermining national sovereignty and espionage for sending a June 2026 letter to U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, offering institutional cooperation contingent on his potential presidential election. Solla claims the act constitutes crimes under Articles 359-I and 359-K of the Brazilian Penal Code, alleging it sought to influence U.S. economic coercion against Brazil and tie institutional cooperation to electoral outcomes.

item.title: Alvaro Dias lidera disputa ao Senado no Paraná, diz pesquisa
item.description: Alvaro Dias (MDB) leads the Senate race in Paraná according to a Vox Brasil poll released on July 3, 2026, based on 2,000 interviews with a 2.6 percentage point margin of error. Gleisi Hoffmann (PT), Deltan Dallagnol (Novo), Filipe Barros (PL), and Alexandre Curi (Republicanos) are technically tied for second place. The survey, registered with the TSE under PR-09668/2026, also measured candidate rejection rates.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai aos EUA falar em audiência pública sobre tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential pre-candidate, will attend a U.S. public hearing next Tuesday (7) to discuss threats of 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, particularly tied to the Section 301 investigation into PIX and other trade practices. He aims to position himself as an interlocutor with Donald Trump, promising legislative action to block PIX internationalization, while Brazil has already submitted a diplomatic response rejecting U.S. criticisms.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro classificam carta aos EUA como munição para Lula
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro criticized his letter to the U.S. government requesting a delay on tariffs, calling it 'ammunition' for Lula, who labeled it subservient and traitorous. Bolsonaro aims to avoid politically benefiting Lula with the tariffs, but allies admit his closeness to Trump creates backlash requiring damage control in the campaign.

item.title: A volta de Flávio ao Ceará, o epicentro da crise com Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his visit to Ceará on the 10th, where he will hold campaign events alongside André Fernandes and Alcides Fernandes, reinforcing the PL alliance in the state. The trip follows a family rift with Michelle Bolsonaro, whose departure from PL Mulher was linked to Ciro Gomes’ support for the Ceará government. Flávio’s presence aims to signal that the disagreement with Michelle has been resolved and to strengthen Bolsonaro’s support in the Northeast.

item.title: Alcolumbre atua para deixar PEC do fim da 6 X 1 para depois das eleições
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) is working to delay the vote on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule until after the October 2026 elections, avoiding bringing it to the floor before the July 17 parliamentary recess. Although government and union leaders, including Paulo Paim (PT-RS), expressed optimism after a July 1 meeting, claiming Alcolumbre is 'in tune with popular sentiment,' he questioned the transition timeline and indicated the proposal will only proceed after textual adjustments and committee review, likely pushing its analysis beyond the election period.

item.title: Charge do JCaesar: 3 de julho
item.description: The JCaesar cartoon published on July 3, 2026, satirizes the electoral debates of the 2026 Brazilian elections, highlighting the presence of figures such as Jair Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro in the political landscape. The humor points to polarization and the rise of the far right in the electorate, using art to critique the rhetoric and dynamics of the candidates.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: pesquisa AtlasIntel mostra o resultado que mais preocuparia o eleitor
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll found that 48.4% of voters fear a Flávio Bolsonaro victory more, compared to 42.4% who fear Lula’s re-election, revealing a stronger 'negative vote' against the Bolsonaro candidate. Despite Lula leading in vote intentions (46.3% in the first round and 48.8% in a potential runoff), he remains below the 50% threshold, suggesting an electoral ceiling tied to polarization and fear of the opponent. The 2026 race appears driven less by enthusiasm and more by the desire to prevent the adversary’s win.

item.title: O Republicanos está dividido, diz ex-ministro de Lula sobre eleição presidencial
item.description: The Republicans party is divided on its presidential strategy for 2026, according to Deputy Silvio Costa Filho. Some factions support Lula, others back Flávio Bolsonaro, and some advocate for state-level neutrality, while Costa Filho reaffirmed his support for President Lula. The party plans to begin internal discussions in July to define its position.

item.title: Sergio Moro lidera disputa pelo governo do Paraná, diz pesquisa
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL) leads the race for governor of Paraná in all first and second-round scenarios tested, according to a Vox Brasil poll released on July 3, 2026. The survey, with a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points and 95% confidence, also measured candidate rejection. The study, registered with the TSE under PR-09668/2026, cost R$50,000 and was self-funded.

item.title: Lula inaugura túnel da transposição sem água no RN
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva inaugurated the Major Sales Tunnel, part of the Apodi branch of the São Francisco River Transposition project, in Luís Gomes (RN), although water had not yet arrived at the site due to a 'calculation error' in the schedule. He emphasized the historical significance of the project for the semi-arid region, linking water scarcity to governmental lack of credibility, and urged residents to document the water's arrival at midnight.

item.title: TRUMP AVANÇA CONTRA PCC / MENDONÇA X PF DE LULA / ELEIÇÕES 2026 📱
item.description: The content suggests a narrative about Donald Trump allegedly acting against the Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) and a supposed dispute involving Justice Minister Ricardo Lewandowski (referred to as 'Mendonça', possibly by error or nickname), the Federal Police, and the Lula government, all in the context of the 2026 elections. There is no verifiable or concrete information in the provided text to confirm these claims; the material appears to be a snippet from a YouTube video description containing generic elements and possibly misleading information.

item.title: Flávio promete a Trump Pix, Mercosul, soberania, terras raras e honra
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL candidate, promises in a letter to Donald Trump to align Brazil’s policies with U.S. interests, including conditionally imposing tariffs based on election outcomes (favorable if he wins, unfavorable if Lula wins), dissolving Mercosul to benefit the U.S., granting rare earth minerals to the U.S., and using PIX as an economic alignment tool. His stance reflects a vision of strategic Brazilian subordination to the U.S., prioritizing personal and partisan gains over national sovereignty.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro quer premiar Trump pelo ataque ao Pix
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes rewarding Donald Trump for attacking Pix, claiming the Brazilian payment system harms foreign companies like Visa and Mastercard. The statement emerges amid rising trade tensions between the U.S. and Brazil, with Washington accusing Pix of unfair competition practices. The federal deputy argues Brazil should compensate Trump for alleged damages to American corporations.

item.title: Crusoé: Atropelada
item.description: Lula’s government entered its third year politically weakened, with 2025 beginning with the dollar at record levels due to the botched announcement of fiscal adjustment by Fernando Haddad. In an attempt to recover and remain politically viable for this year’s election, the president abandoned any pretense of fiscal responsibility, deepening the crisis of confidence.

item.title: Gratuidade do Farmácia Popular é maior acerto de Lula, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: The free provision of medicines through the Farmácia Popular program was rated as the main success of Lula's government by 84% of respondents in the June 2026 AtlasIntel/Bloomberg survey, followed by income tax exemption for earnings under R$ 5,000 (80%). The fiscal arcabouço and reversal of privatizations were the worst-rated policies, seen as errors by 46% and 48% respectively. Lula holds the highest positive image among tested leaders at 46%, while Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has the worst, with 90% negative perception.

item.title: Para 50%, novos casos de corrupção de Lula são “muito prováveis”
item.description: According to the Latam Pulse survey from June, released by AtlasIntel/Bloomberg, 50% of Brazilians consider it 'very likely' that new corruption cases involving President Lula will emerge during the remainder of his third term. An additional 34% view this scenario as probable to some extent, while only 10% and 7% deem it 'unlikely' or 'very unlikely', respectively. The survey, with a 1 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level, also finds that a coup d'état and Lula's removal from office are seen as unlikely by most respondents.

item.title: Para 52%, economia do Brasil está “ruim”
item.description: The June 2026 Latam Pulse survey by AtlasIntel/Bloomberg shows that 52% of Brazilian voters view the country's economic situation as 'bad', while 36% rate it as 'good' and 13% as 'normal'. Despite current pessimism, 48% expect economic improvement in the next six months, compared to 39% anticipating deterioration and 13% foreseeing no change. The poll surveyed 4,999 people nationwide from June 26–30, with a 1 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Argentina x Cabo Verde na Copa: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Argentina and Cape Verde face off on Friday, July 3, at 7:00 p.m. Brasília time, in Miami, in the Round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Argentina, the defending champions and undefeated in Group J, are expected to start Lionel Messi. Cape Verde, making its World Cup debut, advanced to the knockout stage unbeaten with three draws and made history as the least populous nation to reach a World Cup knockout round.

item.title: Análise: Flávio Bolsonaro tem ataque de 'sincericídio' e negocia com os EUA tarifaço para depois das eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro urged U.S. authorities to delay a potential tariff on Brazilian goods until after the 2026 elections, a move described as a 'political slip of the tongue' because it reveals his priority is avoiding electoral damage, not resolving the trade dispute. Lula condemned the request, accusing the Bolsonaro family of acting against national interests and potentially inviting new U.S. tariffs to undermine his re-election bid. Flávio’s strategy weakens his bargaining power by publicly disclosing his intent to delay the measure.

item.title: PT explora críticas de aliado de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre voto feminino
item.description: The PT published a video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to influencer Paulo Figueiredo, who claimed women 'vote poorly,' especially single women, and criticized Michelle Bolsonaro. The video implies that Flávio’s allies could influence his presidential decisions. Flávio publicly rejected Figueiredo’s remarks, stating he is not part of his campaign, though Figueiredo said he remains supportive.

item.title: Entre trancos e barrancos
item.description: The 2026 presidential campaign between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro is characterized by weak debates and mutual blame-shifting, with few merits highlighted and an emphasis on opponents' mistakes. Lula leans on his past record and blames external forces like the market and agribusiness for Brazil's problems, while Flávio relies on his father's political legacy and struggles with internal divisions within bolsonarism. Both lack a new agenda, reducing the race to who makes fewer errors amid political fatigue and reliance on legacy.

item.title: Ambos negam, mas Paulo Figueiredo dita o que Flavio Bolsonaro fala
item.description: Paulo Figueiredo is shaping Flávio Bolsonaro’s statements, despite both denying any direction. The conflict escalated after a video by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro criticized the pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, sparking accusations of gender-based political violence, as reported by Thais Bilenky in A Hora on UOL.

item.title: O que a overdose de propaganda oficial revela sobre Lula e o PT
item.description: The Lula government allocated a record R$ 520 million for official propaganda in the first half of 2026, during an election year, according to Folha de S.Paulo. Actress Luana Piovani condemned the spending as 'a slap in the face of Brazilians,' questioning the prioritization of funds amid ongoing social challenges.

item.title: Pesquisas internas detectam desgaste de Flávio junto a público feminino
item.description: Internal polls show growing wear of Flávio Bolsonaro among female voters, particularly following his public feud with stepmother Michelle Bolsonaro and the misogynistic statement by his ally Paulo Figueiredo. The gap between the candidate and women voters has widened this week, according to daily voter monitoring conducted for politicians and financial market agents.

item.title: Ministro de Lula contraria Banco Mundial ao propor imposto do pecado ‘light’
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan opposed a World Bank study by advocating for maintaining current tax levels on harmful products (alcohol, tobacco, betting) when the selective tax begins in 2027, aiming to avoid controversial debates. The Lula government fears electoral backlash from tax increases ahead of the 2026 elections, though the Ministry states that final rates depend on congressional approval.

item.title: Kassio aciona Múcio e pede militar com experiência em licitações para atuar no TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, requested the Ministry of Defense to nominate a Brazilian Army subtennant with experience in public procurement and management to assist the Electoral Court. The letter addressed to Defense Minister José Múcio Monteiro asks for a military officer with solid experience in legal and administrative processes, contracts, agreements, and logistics.

item.title: Lula diz que eleitor precisa pensar na família ao escolher candidato
item.description: Lula da Silva stated that voters must consider their family and future when choosing the next president, urging them to research candidates' biographies to avoid electing someone who would harm the country, likening it to putting a 'fox in the henhouse'. He emphasized evaluating which candidate delivered more in essential areas and who is most respected internationally, and asked Governor Elmano de Freitas to keep the campaign at a high level.

item.title: Governo Lula leva aos EUA "mapa" de compensações para evitar tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government presented U.S. officials with a 'roadmap' offering compensatory measures in areas such as digital trade, intellectual property, ethanol, and illegal deforestation to avoid a proposed 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods. The proposal, shared during negotiations in Washington, aims to show that Brazilian policies do not distort U.S. trade, while keeping the Pix payment system off the negotiating table. Machinery, health equipment, and information technology are three sectors that could be discussed for mutual tariff reductions.

item.title: Após crise com Michelle, Flávio defenderá indicação de mulheres ao STF
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential hopeful, plans to publicly advocate for the appointment of women to the STF as part of a strategy to regain female voters after criticism from his former stepdaughter, Michelle Bolsonaro. He intends to focus especially on the vacancy left by Minister Cármen Lúcia, the only woman currently on the court, and has already held a meeting with conservative women in Brasília.

item.title: EUA: Flávio e Figueiredo vão culpar Lula por acusações contra o Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo will attend a USTR public hearing on July 6, blaming the Lula government and Brazil’s Supreme Court for U.S. allegations of unfair trade practices, including secret court orders to remove social media content, favoring Pix, insufficient anti-corruption enforcement, inadequate counterfeit enforcement, and disrupted ethanol tariff reciprocity, which could trigger a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Michelle deixa comando do PL Mulher com saldo de 72 mil filiações
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro stepped down from leading PL Women after overseeing over 72,000 new female party affiliations between March 2023 and May 2026, contributing to a total of 397,000 women affiliated with the party by 2025. Under her leadership, the PL elected 1,005 women in the 2024 municipal elections, with 995 retaining office — including 61 mayors, such as Emilia Correia of Aracaju, one of only two women elected to lead Brazilian state capitals that year. Party officials credit her efforts in structuring women’s directories across all 26 states and the Federal District for the party’s gains in female representation.

item.title: Eleições: governo Lula entrega obras em 12 cidades antes de restrições
item.description: The Lula government is delivering simultaneous infrastructure projects in 12 cities across seven states before electoral restrictions ban inaugurations starting Saturday. The events include openings of federal institute campuses, health units, and Minha Casa, Minha Vida housing, with participation from ministers and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin. The initiative aims to highlight government achievements in education, health, and housing ahead of the official election campaign.

item.title: Flávio recorre (de novo) a Trump e levanta a bola para gol de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested the U.S. government delay tariffs on Brazilian exports until after the 2026 elections, arguing they would give Lula a political advantage. The move was criticized by Noblat as a tactical error that ended up benefiting the government, and Lula labeled the request as an act of treason against the nation.

item.title: Lista apreendida na casa de Adilsinho tinha codinomes, mas PF identificou dois: 'Barba' e 'Pastor'
item.description: The Federal Police identified two code names in a list seized at the home of bicheiro Adilsinho in 2022: 'Barba', referring to former Alerj president Rodrigo Bacellar, and 'Pastor', linked to pastor Márcio Poncio. Both were tied to a money laundering scheme connected to the illegal gambling operation and had arrest warrants issued by the Supreme Court under ADPF 635, with Poncio arrested in a recent operation and Bacellar already detained in an earlier phase of Operation Unha and Carne.

item.title: Aliados do PL "abandonam" Michelle Bolsonaro após briga com Flávio
item.description: Allies of the PL abandoned Michelle Bolsonaro following her public feud with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, with only Senator Damares Alves expressing support. PL president Valdemar Costa Neto criticized her for sharing an unverified video by Anthony Garotinho about alleged parties involving Daniel Vorcaro, calling it a mistake. The conflict arose amid political maneuvering in Ceará, where Michelle opposes the PL’s alignment with Ciro Gomes, while Flávio seeks to limit the damage.
